To compute the n-th Fibonacci number modulo 1000000007 efficiently, we use matrix exponentiation. This method allows us to calculate the Fibonacci number in logarithmic time using fast exponentiation of the transformation matrix [[1, 1], [1, 0]].

The function `fib_mod` will take a `u64` parameter `n` and return a `u32` result. We'll implement this using the matrix exponentiation approach, which is suitable for large values of `n`.

Here is the implementation of the function `fib_mod` in the Omega machine's binary IR format:

```

06000000

0e 0200 0100 0200
```
